On 30 April 1945, Adolf Hitler committed suicide by gunshot [ a ] [ b ] in the Führerbunker when it became clear that Germany would lose the Battle of Berlin , which resulted in Germany's surrender to the Allies and the end of World War II in Europe . His wife Eva Braun , whom he had married the day before, committed suicide with him via cyanide poisoning . [ c ] That afternoon—in accordance with Hitler's prior written and verbal instructions —the couple's corpses were carried out of the Führerbunker and cremated in the garden of the Reich Chancellery . [ 1 ] [ 2 ] His death was announced in German radio broadcasts on 1 May. [ 3 ] Hitler had served as the Führer of Germany since 1933 and of the Nazi Party since 1921.
